methodology: Automated real-time session on the layered street with new enemy encounters (2.5D view). Test hook is read-only: no teleports, no clock changes, no changes to health, enemies, inventory or RNG. All actions use visible buttons and real keyboard/mouse, including E opening and native inventory drag for crates and corpses. This is not a human fun/balance evaluation.
observationPolicy: Before the first street windup: walk the authored public west/cross street, approach a visible new enemy, and wait for its real preparation before shooting it. No game-state mutations.
